findings.description: The cycle guard on the walk over the exception __cause__ chain was removed, so a cyclic chain makes the while loop spin forever when no cause matches exception_cause_types.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a retried function raises an exception whose __cause__ chain loops back on itself (e.g. e1.__cause__ = e2 and e2.__cause__ = e1 set manually) and no exception in the chain is an instance of the configured cause types. The loop then never reaches None and never breaks, because the removed seen-set was the only termination guard for cycles. Impact: the retry decision hangs the calling thread instead of returning False and propagating the error.
